read anywhere in the engine files it under **Engine** even when scripts read it too, and

or a shell pass-through is listed, but does not outvote the engine).

**Summary:** 432 variables, 57 presence-gated, 10 mixed, 213 documented nowhere before this page.

**Kind** is a heuristic read of the code around each read site:

- `presence` -- only the existence of the variable is tested (`qEnvironmentVariableIsSet`,
  `if getenv(...)`, `"X" in os.environ`, `[ -n "$X" ]`). **`=0` ARMS it** -- the
  `OMNISIM_REQUIRE_NEWTON` trap; UNSET it to disarm.
- `value` -- the string is compared or lowered (`== "0"`, `.trimmed().toLower()`,
  `.lower() in (...)`); by convention `0` / `false` / `off` mean OFF and anything else ON.
- `int` -- parsed as a number.
- `string` -- used as a path, name, URL or opaque value.
- `mixed (...)` -- presence at some read sites and value/int/string at others: the
  inconsistent class, where `=0` arms one site and disarms another.

**Documented** means the name appears in `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `PROTOCOL.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md` or any `docs/**/*.md` other than this page; a variable named nowhere else
is marked *(undocumented elsewhere)*. **Description** is the nearest source comment above
(or trailing) the first read site, clipped to 160 characters; an empty cell means the code
carries no comment there.
